summary: This is a Docker Compose configuration file that defines a single service called 'memos'. It sets up a containerized memos application (a note-taking app) that will run on port 5230, store its data in a local 'data' folder, and automatically restart if it crashes.

explanations.7: The 'init: true' setting ensures that the container uses an init process to properly handle signals and clean up child processes, preventing zombie processes from accumulating.
explanations.8: This sets the user ID and group ID that the container runs as; it uses environment variables UID and GID if available, otherwise defaults to 1000 for both, which is a common unprivileged user ID.
explanations.10: The '%%port=5230%%' syntax is a template variable that gets replaced with the actual port number during deployment; the right side (5230) is the internal port the application listens on.
explanations.13: The 'unless-stopped' restart policy means the container will automatically restart if it crashes, but won't restart if you explicitly stop it.
